what: Hovering an accent-colored button widens a pale disc hidden off to the left by the button width over 1s ease-out, spreading to double size, and .4s later a second-color fill (default: orange, opposite the accent) covers the button from the left in .4s. On release the fill withdraws at once in .15s and the disc shrinks in .5s — for the ”Learn more” button of local clinics and shops

options.--fx-fill: Cover surface color, default orange rotated from the accent color (oklch l×1.2186 c×1.3332 h−189.89)
options.--fx-in · --fx-out: Duration for the disc to spread / retract, default 1s · .5s
options.--fx-fill-dur · --fx-fill-delay · --fx-f: Panel cover duration, delay and retract duration, default .4s · .4s · .15s
options.--fx-spill: Margin by which the disc overflows the button (top, bottom, left), default 50px
options.look: bloom: Only the disc spreads, with no second color field

note: Text must be wrapped in a child element (span) to sit above the disc or face. The button background is painted by the user (the original uses the accent color, 5px corners). Does nothing on devices without hover

from.where: shared.css .az-btn (”View list” and ”Clinic info” buttons on every page — original .c-btn01 a:before (#83c5f0 disc, scale 0→2·width 0→100%, 1s ease-out / retract .5s) · :after (#ff8c39 face, width 0→100% .4s delay .4s ease-out / retract .15s))
